notes: The answers make this free-riding with no lap count and no finish, which is exactly the case Racing's boundary note hands to Simulation, so Simulation leads and Racing is named second for the track itself. The space is still a bike track ridden around, so I took route-circuit from Racing's list — shapes are shared — and its P6 stands, because a trail only works if it reads as one continuous connected route. Physics Sim is the preset: the jumps and drop-ins are precisely physics-rig's ramps and the trail is path-circulation, while hazard-kill was dropped since free-riding has no run to end. terrain-relief carries the wooded dirt trail and its drop-ins, which is real landform and adds tiered to the route; first person and 'realistic' are camera and art direction, so neither changes the layout.
